newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian railways subsidises children demonstration.
newsitem.headline: Belgian railways subsidises children demonstration.

text.p: Belgian railways, reacting to public anger over revelations of child kidnapping and abuse, said on Monday it would subsidise a national demonstration in support of victims and parents of missing and abused children.

SNCB/NMBS railways said in a statement that return train tickets to Brussels from any station in Belgium would cost just 200 francs ($6) -- the price that usually applies to travel to and from the capital from a radius of about 20 kilometres.
It would also put on extra trains to cope with the massive turnout expected for the demonstration on October 20.

Belgium has been shaken by a scandal prompted by discovery of the bodies of four young people kidnapped by a convicted paedophile. Police believe the deaths could point to an international network of paedophiles. ($1=31.53 Belgian Franc)
